name: Spicy Chipotle Tofu Tacos
description: Crispy, protein-packed tofu crumbles tossed in a smoky chipotle glaze, served in warm corn tortillas with fresh toppings. A perfect vegan weeknight dinner.

instructions.description: Press the tofu for at least 15 minutes to remove excess moisture. Once pressed, crumble the tofu into bite-sized pieces with your hands into a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chopped chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, lime juice, and maple syrup. Set aside.
Sprinkle the cornstarch, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt over the crumbled tofu. Toss gently until the tofu is evenly coated.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu in a single layer. Cook undisturbed for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Stir the tofu and continue cooking for another 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crispy on all sides.
Reduce heat to low. Pour the sauce mixture over the tofu and toss quickly to coat. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce glazes the tofu and thickens slightly.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a gas flame for char marks.
Assemble the tacos by placing a scoop of spicy tofu onto each tortilla. Top with shredded cabbage, avocado slices, and fresh cilantro.

notes: For extra heat, add a pinch of cayenne pepper to the spice mix. Serve with vegan sour cream or a squeeze of fresh lime.
